picks.editorial_note: NSF's $1.5B X-Labs initiative adding a dedicated AI-for-Physical-Systems funding call signals a major federal bet on AI-driven scientific infrastructure, with ripple effects across the entire university research funding landscape.

picks.editorial_note: A $15M gift from the OpenAI Foundation to build an open-source pharmacokinetic data platform is a notable industry-academia partnership that could accelerate AI-driven drug development broadly, not just at UCSF.
picks.title: A Gift to Help Scientists Predict How Drugs Behave in the Body

picks.editorial_note: NSF's new ELEGANT program ties AI hardware progress directly to U.S. semiconductor manufacturing competitiveness, reflecting a policy-level push to secure domestic chip supply chains for next-gen AI compute.
picks.title: NSF invests in translating low-dimensional semiconductor technologies to establish U.S. leadership in microelectronics

picks.editorial_note: A $26.5M ARPA-H award for an AI 'co-pilot' aimed at rural medical care represents a significant government investment in using AI to address real healthcare access gaps.
picks.title: Reuters covers SRI's work in the ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM program - SRI

picks.editorial_note: Unifying protein sequence and 3D structure in a single language model is a genuine scientific advance that could reshape how researchers map evolutionary and functional relationships across the proteome.
picks.title: Uniting sequence and structure to map the protein universe | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's hardware-as-neural-network approach to 'physical AI' points toward fundamentally more energy-efficient computing architectures, a breakthrough direction as AI's power demands become a bottleneck.
picks.title: Toward physical AI: When the hardware becomes the neural network

picks.editorial_note: A $5M multi-university NSF award to build national privacy-preserving data-sharing infrastructure addresses a core barrier to collaborative AI research across institutions.
